title: PBA: NLEX nails quarters berth with record rout of Macau
summary: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX, behind new import Deonte Burton, hit two birds with one stone in routing hapless guest team Macau, 138-78, as the PBA Governors’ Cup finally resumed from a long break on…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX, behind new import Deonte Burton, hit two birds with one stone in routing hapless guest team Macau, 138-78, as the PBA Governors’ Cup finally resumed from a long break on Wednesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. The 60-point victory enabled the Road Warriors to secure the first quarterfinals berth in Group A while also setting the record for the most lopsided game in league history, erasing the previous mark of 56. That margin, which Rain or Shine orchestrated at the expense of Blackwater, 151-95, in the Commissioner’s Cup, came only last March. READ: NLEX eyes quarters spot as PBA Governors’ […]...
